map.上传图片后自动切成 3×3，并可分别下载。: After uploading an image it is cut into 3×3 automatically, and each piece can be downloaded separately.
map.九宫格切图把正方形图均分为 3 × 3 共 9 块：单块尺寸 = 原图边长 ÷: The nine-grid cutter divides a square image evenly into 3 × 3 for 9 blocks: single block size = original side ÷ 3 (rounded to integer); the crop origin of block (row, column) is x = (column − 1) × block width, y = (row − 1) × block height, with both dimensions equal to the block size; the original should be cropped or scaled to a square first (take the smaller of width and height) to avoid stretch distortion; it outputs 9 equal-sized images for nine-grid posting on social platforms.
map.📚 深度解析：九宫格切图（3×3 朋友圈）: 📚 In-depth analysis: nine-grid cutting (3×3 moments grid)
map.发朋友圈长图被压缩，想切成九宫格拼回大图。: A long image posted to moments gets compressed, so cut it into a nine-grid to reassemble the large image.
map.做九格海报合集，每格独立保存。: Make a nine-cell poster set with each cell saved separately.
map.正方形图 900×900，按 3×3 均分，每格 300×300，导出 9 张编: A square image of 900×900 divided evenly into 3×3 gives each cell 300×300 and exports 9 PNGs numbered 1–9.
map.1200×1200 图每格 400×400，九张拼回原图无缝；非正方形会先按短边: Each cell of a 1200×1200 image is 400×400, and the nine reassemble seamlessly into the original; a non-square image is cropped to a square by the shorter edge first.
map.非正方形图怎么切？: How do you cut a non-square image?
map.工具通常先按短边裁成正方形再 3×3 均分，保证九格等大、拼回不变形。: The tool usually crops to a square by the shorter edge and then divides into 3×3, ensuring the nine cells are equal and reassemble without distortion.
map.按行优先 1–9 从左到右、从上到下发布，朋友圈九宫格即还原原图。: Publish 1–9 in row-major order, left to right then top to bottom, and the moments nine-grid reproduces the original image.
